name: library/stateful_values
features: optional disengagement, emplace replacement and move construction preserve exact tracked lifetimes
bad_optional_access and bad_variant_access unwind to typed handlers
variant alternative replacement destroys the previous tracked object
move-only variant alternatives retain their index and specified moved-from state
single-variant and Cartesian two-variant visitation produce actual alternative-dependent values

name: library/views_ranges
stdout: views=3 sorted=2,3,1 pipeline=63 evaluations=3 text=dElta empty=1
features: nonzero span subviews mutate only their original storage range
ranges sort and find apply member-pointer projections
string_view substrings observe mutation at their nonzero base offset
filter-transform pipelines defer transformation until dereference and do not cache transformed values
empty terminal span and string_view subviews and empty transform pipelines remain valid

name: library/bits_bytes
features: runtime 32-bit popcount and leading/trailing zero counts include the all-zero boundary
rotations handle negative and exact-width or multiple-width counts
bit_width, bit_floor, bit_ceil and has_single_bit distinguish zero and ordinary values
bit_cast transfers a specified 32-bit value through a four-byte aggregate and back
std::endian selects byte-order checks and least-significant-byte mutation without assuming native endian

name: library/vector_exceptions
features: a real std::allocator-backed stateful allocator tracks live allocation blocks and slots
partial-copy failure during reserve preserves vector values, size, capacity and data address
throwing appended constructors preserve a full vector during reallocation and a vector with spare capacity
successful reallocation and append retain correct values without asserting incidental move counts or capacities
failed operations destroy intermediate elements and release temporary storage with no leaked lifetimes or allocations

name: library/shared_ownership
features: enable_shared_from_this and weak_from_this share the original owning control block
aliasing shared_ptr owns the enclosing object while exposing and mutating a member
weak ownership stays live while only an alias remains and expires after the final owner releases
shared_from_this on an unowned object throws bad_weak_ptr
over-aligned make_shared, allocate_shared, make_unique and automatic objects satisfy actual pointer alignment
ownership transitions destroy each of four objects exactly once

name: library/synchronized_threads
features: jthread injects a distinct stop_token into each worker callable
latch readiness and two reusable barrier phases publish per-worker state deterministically
barrier completion executes exactly once per phase
stop callbacks execute once and repeated request_stop calls report no new request
counting_semaphore gates both workers until stop has been requested
atomic wait/notify with release/acquire publishes a non-atomic payload without data races or timing assumptions
explicit joins expose deterministic worker results and leave both threads non-joinable

name: library/expected_pipeline
features: from_chars validates full input consumption before expected value/error propagation
expected and_then, transform and or_else run only on their applicable value or error paths
overflow and malformed errors propagate while negative input recovery produces a checked value
bad_expected_access preserves the original error and transform_error translates only error states
lvalue transform receives a mutable reference while rvalue monadic operations transfer a move-only value
expected<void, E> composes a void transform with a value-returning continuation
std::to_underlying preserves the specified scoped-enum error codes
